results.name: backup is one file holding only ciphertext: no names, no content, no tree shape; cleartext entries are skipped and reported
verify opens every entry with the passphrase AND with the recovery key; wrong secret and a flipped byte are rejected
restore onto a host with no volume recreates header + identical ciphertext rows; the layer reads the plaintext back
restore into the SAME volume merges only what is missing; never overwrites newer files
a DIFFERENT volume on the host is never touched; a backup with one corrupted entry writes nothing at all
amnesic rescue: RAM-only files are listed and moved into /Private/Rescued encrypted; nothing lands in clear; locked refuses
cost: backing up 24 × 256 KiB encrypted files and verifying them is bounded (no decryption on the backup path)
